title: Figure 6.1: p-11B fusion cross-section energy requirements vs IEC well depth
description: Log-log plot titled 'Spherical f(v)' and captioned 'Figure 6.1. p-11B Fusion Cross Section Energy Requirements. The p-11B reaction rate approaches that of D-T at very high energies, i.e. deep potential wells.' Reaction rate (m^3 s^-1, 10^-27 to 10^-21) is plotted against 'IEC well depth (kV)' (1 to 300) with colored curves for D-T, D-3He, D-D, p-11B and 3He-3He. It appears under the heading 'Proposed Breakeven Experiment'.
